g.text: Each point or bar represents one drug condition; bar labels omit the compound- prefix.
MSE compares per-gene means of per-cell log1p(CPM 10,000).
Input controls are reused; conditions are not independent biological replicates.
Shared reference controls affect delta correlations; no epigenomic prior was used.
Partial-training, non-blind internal diagnostic; not an official challenge score.
